baseline_description: Upstream dmenu 5.4 plus upstream fixes; fork baseline.
notes: Baseline verified as the upstream/local merge-base. -ob/-of outline colors were inherited upstream, not added by this fork.

changes.50644ca: Default launcher to 10 vertical rows; track config.h with font size 14; add build-artifact ignores.
changes.5d2dc6c: Add -c centered placement (900px width cap, Xinerama and fallback); font 14 → 24.
changes.afcf736: Font 24 → 16; synchronize config.def.h; add b build/optional-install script.
changes.6437bf6: Document local build/options; correct CLI usage for -c and existing -ob/-of options.
changes.88bd9e7: Reduce font 16 → 13 in both configuration headers.
changes.02cad08: Document Mint/Void build dependencies; no executable changes.
changes.821c86b: Add dmenu-font Xresources wrapper and launcher fallback; font 13 → 11; install wrapper, add font tests and make check.
